verdicts.why: The check requires every enumerated security category to occur exactly once with a valid explicit outcome. It requires NOT_APPLICABLE to have a rationale, APPLICABLE to reference an indexed accepted decision, and UNRESOLVED to reference an indexed open question while also emitting a blocking error.
